question.text: Compliance Test Reports (CTRs) in the AIF context are:

answer.text: Reports filed by investors with SEBI
Reports ensuring fund activities comply with regulations, PPM terms, and investor agreements
Credit rating reports for investee companies

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, detailed policies and procedures are designed to ensure fund decisions comply with SEBI regulations, PPM terms, investor agreements, fund documents and applicable laws. The Compliance Test Report (CTR) is a SEBI-prescribed annual format in which the AIF manager furnishes compliance with the AIF Regulations and related circulars. The Trap: CTRs are not public stock-exchange filings, nor are they purely internal documents — they are annual SEBI-prescribed compliance reports submitted by the manager to the sponsor/trustee, with any observed violations intimated to SEBI. Note: The CTR mechanism complements, rather than replaces, the AIF's separate internal compliance review processes.
